name: omnibase/legal
description: The legal professions on omnibase, one bundle and a profile for each: a lawyer's firm (the RIN's article 10 - domain name, certified specialisations, fees and their agreement, the declaration to the Ordre), a notary's office (regulated tariff and discounts, addresses in notaires.fr, the declaration to the chamber, the profession's charter), a jurist (nothing the law of 31 December 1971 reserves to a regulated profession). In common, on omnibase/office: fields of practice, a first appointment asked without an account, the client's space on the encrypted vault, who of the practice reads a document, the compliance checks of the back office.

suggest.omnibase/admin: The back office: the fields of practice, the lawyers, the settings, the memo for the Ordre, the compliance widget
suggest.omnibase/marketplace: A lawyer's fee note paid online (fees only, never clients' funds): the fees page links to it when it is installed and legal.lawyer.payment.enabled is set
suggest.omnibase/consulting: A jurist's offerings: the profile's guard refuses one that announces what the law of 31 December 1971 reserves to a regulated profession
